_description: PostProcConfig for the v0.2 submission container -- the single source of truth for the shipped thresholds. Both the container (AUTOPETV_POSTPROC_CONFIG) and the offline harness (interactive_eval.py --postproc_config) read THIS file, so a number measured offline is a number the container reproduces; submission/tests/run_v02_suite.py asserts that by comparing the masks bitwise. Keys starting with '_' are stripped before PostProcConfig.from_dict, which rejects every other unknown key. Anything not listed here keeps the default in src/postproc/config.py.
_variant: B3 lineage (5-channel interactive model + the post-processing ladder), with the cleanup and negative-gate thresholds moved on by the ablation sweep -- see configs/ablations.json for the original rung.
